title: Understanding Negative Feedback
text: In negative feedback, the end product of a process inhibits the process itself. This prevents overproduction and maintains balance (homeostasis).

title: Progesterone's Role
text: During the luteal phase, progesterone from the corpus luteum rises. High progesterone tells the brain 'we might be pregnant, don't start a new cycle' - so it inhibits FSH and LH, preventing new follicle development.
